caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Kentucky River Community Care, Inc.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Kentucky River Community Care, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, November 13, 2000. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, December 13, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 29, 2000. This Court's Rule 29.2 does not apply.
